en.decryption: Remember his title (Amitraghata), his dynasty, his relations with Greek monarchs, the Taxila revolts, and his successor Ashoka.

hi.title: A.M.I.T.R.A
hi.phrase: Amitraghata, Maurya, Indo-Greeks, Taxila, Relations, Ashoka
hi.decryption: Remember his title (Amitraghata), his dynasty, his relations with Greek monarchs, the Taxila revolts, and his successor Ashoka.

fact.en: Do not confuse 'Amitraghata' (Slayer of foes) with 'Devanampiya' (Ashoka's title).
fact.hi: Do not confuse 'Amitraghata' (Slayer of foes) with 'Devanampiya' (Ashoka's title).

fact.en: Do not assume he was a weak ruler; he maintained the vast empire inherited from Chandragupta without significant losses.
fact.hi: Do not assume he was a weak ruler; he maintained the vast empire inherited from Chandragupta without significant losses.

fact.en: Remember, he was not the one who conquered Kalinga; that was Ashoka.
fact.hi: Remember, he was not the one who conquered Kalinga; that was Ashoka.
